question: Do channel-resolved amplitude/phase patterns of the estimated least-stable visible mode add useful information beyond the current42 summaries, especially for optimistic near-stable failures?
extraction: Unchanged selected16, per-channel causal51-sample calibration, cap50, lag64, max8 LS-ESPRIT modes. Retain fitted cosine-minus-i*sine sensor coefficients only when requested. Select largest estimated alpha among >=1%-fitted-energy modes, breaking ties by frequency. No solver mode identity, poles, margins, velocity, ucrit or design geometry enters feature extraction.
features: 65 columns:16 unit-trace complex-shape Gramian diagonal powers; real and imaginary Gramian entries on24 fixed nearest grid-neighbor sensor pairs; explicit availability. Entries use b_i*conj(b_j)/sum(abs(b)^2), invariant to global complex scale/phase and avoiding angle wrap or division by weak channel amplitudes. Fixed sensor identities/edges preserve spatial association. These are patterns of calibrated measured channels, NOT restoration of raw physical amplitude ratios erased by per-channel normalization.
arms: Reuse saved42-feature unweighted baseline and local2 reference. Fit42+65 spatial and matched42+65 jointly-row-shuffled spatial controls, each at seeds42/43/44. Shuffled controls permute the spatial block within outer training/held-out partitions separately, with the same source-row permutation across acquisition views; deterministic seed934+fold, independent of labels and initialization. No noise-copy duplication or design-partition crossing. This is a negative control, not a deployable predictor.
fitting: Same32->16 ReLU MLP, alpha1, unweighted supervised fitting, independent4 equal training views, original five outer design folds seed42, train-only scaling/inactive mask, existing optimization caps. Adding65 inputs increases first-layer parameters; same-width/same-input-count shuffled control addresses this confound. No architecture, edge, mode, alpha, seed or weighting search.
evaluation: All11 cached acquisition conditions, with exact baseline modal-feature replay as acquisition alignment check. Primary clean/fresh iid1% seed932; fresh correlated1% and independent5% seed929 are guardrails. Capture train-design and OOF predictions, averaging metrics/rates rather than predictions or ensembles. Report same stable/unstable .01/.02/.05 slices and farther-stable m>=.15 guardrails as prior studies.
uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-design fixed-prediction resamples, seeds averaged before resampling. No refit/seed uncertainty, multiplicity correction, information-ceiling or safety guarantee. No fitted/default adoption from one exploratory feature ablation.
scope: 77 TRAIN designs/4454 physical clips only. Existing raw acquisition replay, no structural simulation or reserved selection/calibration/test scoring. Atomic source-fingerprinted per-design extraction and per-fit prediction shards resume completed work. GRU remains a later improved-representation comparison.
